title: Gut Bacteria Richness Reflects Fiber And Antibiotic Pressure
hook: Daily food and medicine expose why one gut community is richer.
closing: Fiber intake and antibiotic use both shape the gut bacteria people carry.
question: How much fiber did you eat?

segments.say: The Hadza carry about 730 gut bacteria species. That is far richer than the average American gut.
Hadza fiber intake reaches 150 grams daily. That food supply helps explain their richer gut bacteria.
Likely unnecessary prescriptions make up 34% of outpatient antibiotics. That adds another pressure on gut bacteria richness.
